instruction: Look at `vias.brd` in EAGLE. The board contains 8 vias, all drilled to `0.3 mm`. Shrink the three vias listed in `/home/user/Desktop/targets.txt` to `0.2 mm` drill and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd`. Requirements: - `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd` remains a well-formed EAGLE 7.x board XML file. - It still has exactly 8 `<via>` elements. - The three vias at the coordinates listed in `/home/user/Desktop/targets.txt` have `drill="0.2"`. - The other five vias still have `drill="0.3"`. - Element, signal, and wire counts match the starter exactly; do not delete or reroute anything. Only resize vias listed in `/home/user/Desktop/targets.txt`.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(8); w, h = pyautogui.size(); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 100, h/2 + 25); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 213, h/2 + 146); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 - 80, h/2 + 68); time.sleep(5)
